x-e-e5-04.title: Fikirkaagu wuu is beddelaa markaad akhrinayso boosterka
x-e-e5-04.topic: Weydiinta su'aalo si loo hubiyo macluumaadka
x-e-e5-04.goal: Beddel xukunkaaga mar kasta oo macluumaadka boosterka hal-hal loo muujiyo, oo samee su'aal Ingiriisi ah oo hubisa macluumaadka aan boosterka ku jirin.
x-e-e5-04.material: Jun xubin ma ahan Green Library. Saaxiibkiis Ara waa xubin Green Library. Labadooda waxay akhrin doonaan boosterka hor taagan maktabadda hal sadar mar kasta.
x-e-e5-04.thinking.0: Beddel xukunkaaga mar kasta oo aad la kulanto macluumaad cusub
x-e-e5-04.thinking.2: Kala sooc waxa mar hore la jawaabay iyo waxa aadan weli aqoonin
x-e-e5-04.prereq.0: Macnaha free, member, friend, iyo won (KRW)
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal qeyb mar. Mar kasta, saadaali lacagta Jun bixin doono adigoo isticmaalaya macluumaadka ilaa hadda.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi haddii weedhda cusub ee markan ay beddelayso xukunkaagii hore.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.hint.1: Si taxaddar leh u akhri si aad u kala sooctid in Jun ama Ara uu yahay xubin.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Cinwaanka boosterka: FREE ART CAMP! This Sunday. Green Library.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Cinwaankan oo keliya eegaya, Jun ma bixin doonaa lacag?
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Cinwaanka oo keliya wuxuu u eg yahay 'bilaash', laakiin waxaa laga yaabaa inay shuruud ku jirto far yar.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waxaan u malaynayaa inuusan u baahnayn inuu bixiyo.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kani waa qiyaas koowaad xukumaysa FREE ee cinwaanka oo keliya.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan wax badan akhriyo si aan u ogaado.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kani waa xukun arkay in shuruud ay jiri karto cinwaanka dibaddiisa.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Weli ma jiraan erayo u sheegaya inuu bixiyo.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Far yar: Free for Green Library members. Other children: 5,000 won.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Jun ma aha xubin. Hadda, imisa ayaa Jun bixin doonaa?
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Waa bilaash xubnaha oo keliya, 5,000 won-na carruurta kale, sidaas darteed Jun wuxuu bixiyaa 5,000 won.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad seegtay shuruudda ah waa bilaash xubnaha oo keliya.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxaan helay xariiqda carruurta aan xubnaha ahayn oo waan ku xiray.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Erayo sheegaya inaan loo oggolayn inuu ku biiro ma jiraan.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Xariiqda hoose: Members can bring one friend for free.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Haddii Jun uu la tago Ara, oo xubin ah, imisa ayuu bixin doonaa?
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Xubin wuxuu keeni karaa hal saaxiib oo bilaash ah. Ara waa xubin, sidaas darteed haddii Jun uu la tago Ara waa bilaash.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mar kale hubi haddii xariiqda cusubi ku habboon tahay xaaladda Jun.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 5,000 won (sababtoo ah Jun ma aha xubin)
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad eegtay shuruudda xariiqda hore oo keliya mana aadan tixgelin xariiqda cusub.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 0 won (sababtoo ah waa saaxiib Ara keenayso)
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxay ku xirtaa xariiqda cusub xiriirka u dhexeeya labada qof.
x-e-e5-04.s.s1.reflect: Waxaad beddeshay xukunkaaga 'bilaash' xariiqda labaad, oo mar kale ayaad beddeshay xariiqda saddexaad. Dib u eeg erayada beddelay xukunkaaga, iyo waxa maqnaa markii aad marka hore aaminsatay cinwaanka oo keliya.
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.prompt: Waxaa jira macluumaad boosterku weli bixin (tusaale ahaan, waqtiga uu bilaabmayo, sida isu-diiwaangelinta). Qor hal weedh Ingiriisi ah oo ah su'aal hubisa macluumaad noocan ah. Ka tag su'aalaha lacagta, sababtoo ah kuwaas mar hore ayaa la jawaabay.
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.hint.0: Raadi haddii boosterku leeyahay 'taariikhda' laakiin haddii uu leeyahay 'waqtiga' ama 'sida isu-diiwaangelinta'.
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro hal wax aadan weli aqoonin, u qor su'aal, oo ku dar calaamadda su'aasha.
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jawaabta su'aashayda runtii ma ku jirto boosterka?
x-e-e5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Su'aashu ma weydiisaa si cad hal wax oo keliya?

x-e-e5-01.title: 'Most popular' - ma qoraalku taageeraa?
x-e-e5-01.topic: Fikirka ugu weyn iyo faahfaahinta taageerada
x-e-e5-01.goal: Ka fikir haddii macluumaadka tirada ee qoraalka ay taageerto sheegasho (caan), oo samee su'aal Ingiriisi ah oo lagu hubin karo sheegashada.
x-e-e5-01.material:
Fasalka Mina wuxuu leeyahay geeska akhriska oo leh rafka buugaagta.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina wuxuu yiri, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
x-e-e5-01.thinking.0: Isbarbar dhig sheegashada iyo faahfaahinta qoraalka
x-e-e5-01.thinking.1: Kala saar waxa 'jira' iyo waxa 'la akhriyo'
x-e-e5-01.prereq.0: Erayada fudud sida most, popular, iyo about
x-e-e5-01.prereq.1: Erayada tirooyinka sida Twelve iyo four
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.prompt: Xukun haddii qoraalku taageerayo hadalka Mina (buugaagta xayawaanka ayaa ugu caansan).
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir waxa 'popular' ay macnaheedu yahay hadalka Mina, oo raadi weedh qoraalka ku jirta oo taas kuu sheegaysa.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii 'imisa ayaa rafka ku jira' iyo 'imisa jeer ayay ardaydu akhriyeen' ay yihiin isla macluumaad.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.a: Caddayntu way ku filan tahay. 12 ka mid ah 20-ka buug waa buugaag xayawaan, sidaa darteed ardaydu waxay u badan tahay inay akhriyaan inta ugu badan.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.a: Dib u eeg haddii aad tirada buugaagta iyo tirada jeer ee la akhriyey u qaadatay isku mid.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.b: Caddayntu kuma filna. Waxay leedahay tirada buugaagta oo keliya, mana sheegto buugaagta ardaydu akhriyaan.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.b: Waxaan isbarbar dhigay haddii macluumaadka sheegashadu u baahan tahay iyo macluumaadka qoraalku bixiyo ay isku mid yihiin.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.c: Caddayntu way ku filan tahay. Macallinku buugaag cusub ma iibsan, sidaa darteed ardaydu waxay akhriyi doonaan buugaag hore oo keliya.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.c: Hubi haddii 'buugaag cusub ma iibsan' ku xidhan yihiin buugaagta caan ah.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.explain: Qoraalku wuxuu sheegayaa tirada buugaagta rafka ku jira oo keliya (12 buug xayawaan, iwm.). Ma sheegto buugaagta ardaydu akhriyaan ama amaahdaan inta badan, sidaa darteed ma hubin karno sheegashada 'most popular'.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.prompt: Si loo hubiyo haddii hadalka Mina sax yahay, su'aal noocee ah ayaad ardayda weydiin lahayd? Qor hal weedh su'aal Ingiriisi ah.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro hal ficil oo muujinaya 'popular' (akhrinta, amaahda, doorashada).
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qor su'aal weydiisa ficilkaas, oo dhammaadka ku dar calaamadda su'aasha.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma jawaabta su'aashayda waxay sheegtaa 'buugaagta ay inta badan akhriyaan'?
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma waxay weydiisaa waxa ardaydu sameeyaan, halkii ay ku weydiin lahayd tirada buugaagta?
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Su'aal kale oo fiican oo ku hubisa tirada jeer ee la amaahday.

x-e-e5-05.topic: Fikirka ugu weyn iyo faahfaahinta taageerada
x-e-e5-05.title: Fikradda ugu weyn iyo weedhaha taageera qoraal ku saabsan beerta dugsiga
x-e-e5-05.goal: Ka dooro fikradda ugu weyn weedhaha, kala sooc faahfaahinta taageerta fikradda ugu weyn iyo xaqiiqooyinka fudud, kadibna naftaada u samee weedh taageeraysa.
x-e-e5-05.thinking.0: Kala sooc fikradda ugu weyn iyo faahfaahinta
x-e-e5-05.thinking.1: Kala saar macluumaadka taageera iyo macluumaadka aan la xiriirin
x-e-e5-05.thinking.2: Samee weedh faahfaahin ah oo ku habboon fikradda ugu weyn
x-e-e5-05.prereq.0: Macnaha garden, plant, insect, iyo seed
x-e-e5-05.prereq.1: Khibradda ah cutub waxaa ka samaysan hal fikrad weyn iyo fikrado yaryar
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.prompt: Weedhee ayaa ugu habboon fikradda ugu weyn ee qoraalka oo dhan?
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig haddii doorasho kasta ay ka hadlayso hal qayb oo qoraalka ah mise ay xambaarsan tahay qoraalka oo dhan.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ku xir hal doorasho weedh kasta oo kale oo qoraalka ah, oo hel tan ku xirta weedhaha ugu badan.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.a: Tani waxay u aragtaa qodobka ugu muhiimsan sida faahfaahin hal weedh ee qoraalka.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.b: Kani waa xaqiiqo sheegta meel. Hubi haddii ay ku xirmayso weedhaha kale.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.c: Tani waxay u aragtaa qodobka ugu muhiimsan sida hal wax oo kaliya oo ka mid ah hawl maalmeedka.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.d: Doorashadani waxay ka fikirtay haddii nuxurka dhowr weedhood loo xiri karo hal.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.explain: Beerista beerta, waraabinta, indho-indheynta iyo qorista cayayaanka, iyo barashada waxa shinnidu sameyso dhammaantood waxaa isku xira fikradda weyn 'beertu waa meel wax lagu barto'. Doorashooyinka kale mid walba waa hal xaqiiqo ka mid ah kuwaas.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan weedhaha taageera fikradda ugu weyn 'The garden helps students learn.'
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.hint.0: Akhri doorasho kasta oo naftaada weydii, 'Kani ma caddayn buu u yahay in ardaydu wax bartaan?'
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore ka tir doorashooyinka run ah laakiin aan wax xiriir ah la lahayn barashada.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.a: Ka fikir haddii ay tahay xaqiiqo ku xirmaysa barashada.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.b: Doorashadani waxay ka fikirtay haddii waxa ardaydu sameeyaan ay yihiin caddayn barasho.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.c: Waxaan helay oo ku xiray weedhda si toos ah u sheegaysa waxa la bartay.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.d: Ka fikir haddii macluumaadka ku saabsan meesha uu muujinayo barasho.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.explain: Indho-indheynta iyo qorista cayayaanka iyo waxa ay ka barteen shinnida waa caddayn barasho. Inuu beertu yar tahay oo ay gym-ka ku xigto waa xaqiiqooyin, laakiin waa macluumaad aan wax xiriir ah la lahayn barashada.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.prompt: Samee hal weedh Ingiriisi ah oo cusub oo taageerta fikradda ugu weyn 'The garden helps students learn.' Waa fiicantahay haddii aysan qoraalka ku jirin.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fikir hal wax ay ardaydu arki karaan ama hal wax ay sameyn karaan beerta.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ku qor hal weedh adigoo isticmaalaya fal sida 'learn, observe, write'.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Weedhdayda ma tahay caddayn ah in ardaydu wax ka barto beerta?
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma ka fogaatay inaad sheegto cabbirka ama goobta beerta oo keliya?
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Weedh kale oo wanaagsan oo ku qortay hawlgal indho-indheyn ah.

x-e-e5-02.title: Hel oo sax sadarka khaldan ee soo koobka Jin
x-e-e5-02.topic: Akhrinta qoraallo gaagaaban, xayeysiisyo, iyo fariimo
x-e-e5-02.goal: Isbarbar dhig qoraal gaaban iyo soo koob sadar sadar, hel sadarka ka hor imanaya qoraalka, oo dib ugu qor Ingiriisi.
x-e-e5-02.material:
Qoraal gaaban oo ku saabsan Ben.

Ben went to the lake on Saturday. He wanted to fish, but it rained in the morning, so he stayed at his uncle's house and played cards. In the afternoon the rain stopped. Ben and his uncle walked to the lake and caught two fish. They cooked the fish for dinner.
x-e-e5-02.thinking.0: Sadar kasta oo soo koobka ah ku hubi weedhaha qoraalka
x-e-e5-02.thinking.1: Hubi kala horreynta dhacdooyinka iyo waqtiga (subax/galab)
x-e-e5-02.thinking.2: Dib u qor weedh si ay ugu habboonaato qoraalka
x-e-e5-02.prereq.0: Erayada fudud sida rain, lake, fish, iyo cook
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.prompt: Jin wuxuu qoraalkan ku soo koobay afar sadar. Dooro sadarka aan waafaqin qoraalka.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sadarrada soo koobka mid-mid u akhri, hel weedha qoraalka ee isla nuxurka uu ka muuqdo, oo dhinac dhinac dhig.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.hint.1: Calaamadee erayada muujinaya waqtiga (morning, afternoon, all day) oo la barbar dhig qoraalka.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 2 waa khalad. Qoraalka, roobku wuxuu da'ay subaxda oo keliya wuuna joogsaday galabta, sidaa darteed Ben wuxuu kalluumeysanayay galabta. Sadarrada 1, 3, iyo 4 waxay waafaqaan qoraalka.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor sadarka khaldan Ingiriisi si uu ugu habboonaado qoraalka. Hal ama laba weedh way ku filan yihiin.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore hel goorma roob da'ay iyo goorma joogsaday qoraalka.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Labadan waqti (subax, galab) geli weedhdaada la sixay.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ka kooban tahay xaqiiqada ah roobku da'ay subaxda oo keliya?
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma waafaqdaa socodka ah, natiijo ahaan, wuxuu kalluumeystay galabta?
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab kale oo ku saxday 'only in the morning'.

x-e-e5-08.topic: Weydiinta su'aalo si loo hubiyo macluumaadka
x-e-e5-08.title: 'Meet at the cinema!' Maxaan weydiiyaa?
x-e-e5-08.goal: Kala saar macluumaadka ka maqan fariinta saaxiib, oo qor su'aalaha aad runtii u baahan tahay Ingiriisi.
x-e-e5-08.material:
Dana iyo Eli waa isu-fasalle. Magaalada Dana ku nooshahay, waxaa jira laba bandhigga filimada, Star Cinema iyo Moon Cinema.

Eli wuxuu Dana u diray fariin qoraal ah.

Eli: "Let's see a movie on Saturday! I will buy the tickets. Meet me at the cinema!"
x-e-e5-08.thinking.0: Kala sooc waxa fariintu mar hore sheegtay iyo waxa ka maqan
x-e-e5-08.thinking.1: Dooro macluumaadka runtii loo baahan yahay ujeeddada (kulanka)
x-e-e5-08.thinking.2: Qor labada su'aalood ee loo baahan yahay Ingiriisi
x-e-e5-08.prereq.1: Qaabab su'aal sida What time ...? / Which ...?
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan waxyaabaha Dana ay tahay inay weydiiso si ay hubaal ugu kulanto Eli Saturday.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore calaamadee macluumaadka qoraalku mar hore bixiyo (maalinta, tigidhada).
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ka hay waxa aad u baahan tahay 'kulanka' oo keliya. Ka tag su'aalaha wanaagsan haddii la haysto laakiin aad la kulmi karto la'aantooda.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.a: Doorashadani waxay ogaatay in macluumaadka loo baahan yahay kulanka uu yahay waqtiga.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.b: Doorashadani waxay ku xirtay xaqiiqada ah in laba bandhigga filimada jiraan iyo qoraalka.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.c: Mar kale hubi haddii qoraalku sheegayo yaa tigidhada iibsanaya.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.d: Waa su'aal wanaagsan in la haysto, laakiin ka fikir haddii runtii loo baahan yahay kulanka.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.explain: Qoraalku wuxuu leeyahay maalinta (Sabtida) iyo in Eli iibsado tigidhada, laakiin ma laha waqtiga ay kulmaan iyo shaashad filim kee. Magaaladu waxay leedahay laba shaashad filim, sidaas darteed waa inaad labadaba weydiisaa. Filimkaaga ugu jecel runtii looma baahna kulanka.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.prompt: Qor Ingiriisi jawaabta Dana u dirto Eli. Ku dar labada su'aalood ee aad runtii u baahan tahay.
